description: The dashboard is served over loopback by the sidecar, and the shell hands it the update offer it would otherwise raise as a native dialog, plus one widget-launch request. This grants that page the event channel the offer arrives on and the four commands behind it — ask what is pending, install it, open the release page, and hand the widget URL to the desktop — and nothing else. Application commands are allowed everywhere by default and refused for a remote window, so they are declared in build.rs and granted here one by one: the sidecar, the tray and the autostart toggle stay unreachable from the page, which is the point of keeping this capability this small.
